title: Contract-first corrective delivery architecture
summary: Split policy/evidence from the hot loop owner into narrow typed modules and execute A2, forward v2.17.21 repair, Design closure, performance/orchestration, then same-SHA cold-start measurement with maximum disjoint fan-out.

current_state.summary: Clean HEAD ecfc48ec2f5f integrates the bounded 16-commit CI-repair delta from 4a0378e7f080, including BUILD-C dependency inversion, exact review graph/runtime binding, evidence/stage fixture and telemetry repair, storage identity correction, and current release-document freshness. It still has no Plan delivery-mode or pair topology, still primes Build lenses, has no explicit zero-lens success receipt or human-only unstarted ReviewKernel rebind, lacks closed live-Codex evaluator/EM observations and Design AC/wiring enforcement, fragments release authority, emits broad loop briefs, lacks binding wave/Retro telemetry, dereferences hosted bare HEAD before verified default-branch binding, and ships a security-methodology pointer to an absent prompt-injection-defense reference. v2.17.20 remains released-incomplete.
evidence_limitations: knowledge.current_state is null in the engine action; this Design therefore cites and bounds current state directly from exact HEAD source files, tests, the baseline graph, the accepted retro, and the signed amendment rather than claiming a complete KB inventory.

No repository architecture.md exists at exact HEAD. The component_map, lane_ownership, graph overlay, and cycle/fan-in/fan-out DoD in this contract are the bounded architecture authority for R-0001 only; final graph scan and independent architecture review must re-attest them.

The exact 4a0378e7f080..ecfc48ec2f5f 16-commit CI-repair delta is now integrated inventory. Plan must consume its incumbent BUILD-C loop-runtime binding, review graph/runtime consistency, stage/evidence fixture repairs, storage identity fix, and release-document freshness rather than replay them; none implements an R-0001 acceptance contract.

baseline_rebind.delta_classification: integrated CI compatibility and regression repair inventory; no R-0001 contract, receipt schema, selected owner, acceptance identity, delivery sequence, or release-authority semantic is implemented or changed
baseline_rebind.graph_reconciliation: The separately scanned clean ecfc48e source graph was enriched with the same six R-0001-to-contract recorded edges. Its 50-module/156-edge node and edge topology is identical to the approved 4a0378e baseline; only exact source file hashes, scanned revision, and content fingerprint changed. The 73abaaaad36e18663bde23523d28a4dcef9474e57ce4307721eda3ef02e3d309 44/152 scan is explicitly non-authoritative because it observed the uncommitted Design overlay and omitted recorded requirement edges.
baseline_rebind.compatibility_effect: No receipt or host/plugin schema changed in the 16-commit delta. The approved N=2.17.21/N-1=2.17.20 emit-before-require matrix and legacy-evidence disposition remain unchanged.

alternatives.name: Contract-first evidence spine
alternatives.description: Narrow stdlib policy/receipt owners with thin existing transition adapters.

gains: Disjoint write owners enable parallel delivery
Every authority seam is executable and severable
tradeoffs.revisit_when: Two adjacent owners show inseparable co-change across two releases.

costs: Mixed authority and poor seam isolation

alternatives.name: CI-only correctness
alternatives.description: Enforce release remotely without runtime changes.

costs: Cannot stop Build lenses or fix host/startup seams
tradeoffs.revisit_when: As redundant attestation after runtime closure.

alternatives.name: Cryptographically authenticated actor authority
alternatives.description: Add signer, verifier, key trust and rotation for human and producer identities. The security lens recommends this when identity authenticity becomes a requirement, but the accepted human authority decision shelves it for R-0001.

gains: Cryptographic actor authenticity beyond host-channel continuity
Independent verification across untrusted producer hosts
costs: Introduces protected signing keys, verifier and rotation/revocation workflow
Expands delivery beyond the accepted no-signing/no-key scope
tradeoffs.revisit_when: A second operator is authorized, producer hosts become untrusted, evidence must be verified externally, or a human explicitly authorizes asymmetric authority design.

alternatives.disposition: Historical future architecture only: no signature, MAC, key, verifier, signer, trust file, implementation edge, Plan task, evaluation claim, or release claim in R-0001.

decision: Select a contract-first evidence spine: delivery_policy, review_authority, producer_observation, wiring_closure, release_evidence, plan_topology, brief_projection, and dispatch_telemetry own closed schemas/validation; loop, review, build_c, checkpoint, repository and Retro remain thin adapters. A host-issued, agent-inaccessible, single-use non-cryptographic capability protects the review-rebind and producer-observation entry seams, while per-task dispatch capabilities default-deny worker surfaces and release-green independently re-queries the protected platform. This is proportional to the six cross-cutting contracts and removes the hot-owner serialization named by the signed authority without inventing signatures, MACs, keys, or actor-authenticity claims.

inventory_only: The exact 16-commit CI-repair delta through ecfc48ec2f5f is integrated, not reimplemented: BUILD-C dependency inversion, review graph/runtime binding, evidence/stage fixtures and telemetry, local repository identity, current CLI/README freshness, and associated regression expectations.

contracts.description: Plan-authorized mode; build requires empty automatic lenses before dispatch.
Append-only human rebind for a provably unstarted kernel; started slots immutable.
Host-observed evaluator/EM exact output identity consumed by gates.
Exact AC selectors and W01-W32 producer-consumer seams.
Distinct feature, release, and override evidence; only release-green grants release authority.
Verified fetched remote default is bound before bare HEAD/checkout.

receipt_contracts.schema_evolution: Strict closed objects; any field evolution is a new schema id with an explicit compatibility diff.
receipt_contracts.host_action_capability: taskplane.host-action-capability/v1 (single-use continuity token; no actor-authenticity claim)

security_authority.scope_decision: R-0001 accepts unauthenticated actor strings as an inherited limitation. No signature, MAC, key, verifier, signer, CA, trust file, rotation workflow, or cryptographic authenticity claim is selected or implied.

host_action_capability.purpose: A host-issued, single-use, non-cryptographic continuity token for review_rebind or producer_observation. It proves that the incumbent host channel delivered an exact-bound action once; it does not prove the human or producer actor identity.
host_action_capability.issuer_and_channel: The trusted host adapter creates the capability and passes an opaque handle directly to the protected consumer through a host-private channel inaccessible to agents, model prompts, repository files, TASKPLANE_HOME and the product EvidenceStore. The product receives only the validated capability projection at the call boundary; an agent cannot create or recover the nonce by writing files.
host_action_capability.closed_values: purpose is review_rebind or producer_observation; cryptographic_authenticity_claimed is exactly false. Inapplicable kernel/task/stage fields are explicit nulls rather than omitted or wildcarded.
host_action_capability.consume_rule: The protected consumer validates every binding, current host session/turn, monotonic sequence, expiry and expected digest, then atomically marks capability_id+nonce consumed in the host-private store before publishing product evidence. Replay, cross-run/kernel/task/stage/session/turn/output use, digest mismatch, expired capability, duplicate sequence, missing handle, or direct-filesystem injection fails before state/receipt/gate mutation.
host_action_capability.remaining_limitation: The attributed actor string in a receipt is observational metadata only. Host-channel continuity and exact-bound single use are not actor authenticity and must never be described as signed, verified, trusted-human, or cryptographically authenticated.

task_dispatch_capability.rule: Each dispatch gets one closed, versioned capability bound to run, source SHA, Design/Plan fingerprints, task, stage, reservation and predecessor. Every authority surface is default-deny; no permission is inherited from the host or another task.
task_dispatch_capability.default_deny: Every omitted or unlisted tool/path/ref/network endpoint/credential handle is denied. release_credentials_available, irreversible_actions_allowed and cryptographic_authenticity_claimed are exactly false for workers; credential_handles contains no release credential. Cross-task/run/ref/path/network/credential reuse fails before tool invocation.
task_dispatch_capability.irreversible_actions: Tag, push, install, publish, credential release and other irreversible actions are absent from worker capabilities. A protected host consumer independently reconstructs release prerequisites and requires a fresh outside-model human recheck before any irreversible action.

platform_release_proof.query_owner: ProtectedReleaseConsumer using PlatformCiQuery outside worker/model authority
platform_release_proof.rule: Immediately before release, independently query the hosted platform for repository identity, protected default branch, exact pushed SHA, workflow/check-run ids, conclusions, required-check set and freshness. Compare those returned facts to the candidate and protected consumer configuration; local receipt assertions alone never prove CI/platform or actor authenticity.
platform_release_proof.irreversible_barrier: After the platform query passes, the protected consumer requests an outside-model human recheck bound to the exact SHA, platform proof fingerprint and intended irreversible action. Workers never receive release credentials.

prompt_injection_reference.status_at_baseline: Missing from released v2.17.20 even though security-methodology.md requires it.
prompt_injection_reference.design_obligation: Implementation must restore an authored and independently reviewed reference whose documented semantic contract is detect -> obstruct -> flag. This Design does not invent or prescribe the reference contents.
prompt_injection_reference.wiring_obligation: W12 binds source bytes, both package members, installed loader result, semantic-contract review receipt and reviewed source digest into wiring closure and release-green.

failure_modes.recovery: Return exact prior result or require the declared user/external/request change; never blind-retry.

failure_modes.mode: Simultaneous ready dispatch exceeds host/session/max-in-flight capacity or races another admission
failure_modes.detection: atomic scheduler CAS and capacity formula
failure_modes.recovery: Exactly one reservation wins; overflow remains ready; terminal event admits next tranche; no reservation at session stop.

failure_modes.mode: Evidence store test or recovery crosses repository/run namespaces
failure_modes.recovery: Refuse operation; teardown only exact store-created disposable namespace.

failure_modes.mode: Execution DAG loses edges/timestamps across replan
failure_modes.detection: append-only generation/supersession validation and edge-complete Retro test
failure_modes.recovery: Block Retro/release-green until DAG reconciliation restores an unambiguous lineage.

failure_modes.mode: Host action capability is replayed, cross-bound, expired, injected through files, or absent
failure_modes.detection: Host-private capability source validates single-use nonce, sequence, session/turn, run, kernel/task/stage, purpose and request/output digest before the protected entry
failure_modes.recovery: Refuse before review binding, observation, gate or receipt mutation; retain prior evidence. Do not infer actor authenticity from an actor string or local file.

failure_modes.mode: Worker attempts an undeclared tool/path/ref/network/credential or irreversible action
failure_modes.detection: Closed task-dispatch capability default-deny enforcement before tool invocation
failure_modes.recovery: Refuse and record bounded attention; never supply release credentials or inherit another task capability.

failure_modes.mode: Platform CI query is stale, wrong-SHA/run/repository, incomplete, or replaced by local receipt claims
failure_modes.detection: Protected release consumer independently queries the hosted platform immediately before release and validates required checks plus outside-model human recheck
failure_modes.recovery: Refuse tag/install/publish; re-query platform or return to CI/human authority. Local receipts remain evidence but not authenticity proof.

failure_modes.mode: Prompt-injection defense reference is absent, semantically incomplete, stale in a package, or digest-unbound
failure_modes.recovery: Block wiring closure and release-green; require authored independent review of detect-obstruct-flag reference content.

risks.mitigation: W12 proves source, both archives, byte freshness, and installed lens load.

risks.risk: Crash between immutable receipt publication, CAS head, and loop/release state update forks authority
risks.mitigation: One lock, expected-head CAS, immutable receipt bytes, fsync ordering, startup reconciliation, and injected crash/concurrency tests.

risks.risk: Duplicate, out-of-order, oversized, or partial-host events double-count usage or fabricate completion
risks.mitigation: Fingerprint+sequence identity, idempotent duplicates, bounded pending queue, 64KiB event cap, 256-event cap, and partial-host attention that cannot become green.

risks.risk: Atomic host/plugin enforcement strands a mixed-version production session
risks.mitigation: Emit-before-require handshake, N/N-1 dual-read window, four-cell mixed matrix, and release refusal without feature/outage confusion.

risks.risk: Schema drift is silently ignored by permissive JSON readers
risks.mitigation: Closed versioned authority schemas, discriminated N/N-1 dispatch, required compatibility diff, and release-green consumption.

risks.risk: Tests depend on live host timing/private stores and become flaky
risks.mitigation: Public injected ports, immutable recorded replay, FakeClock/RecordedEventWaiter, namespaced SandboxEvidenceStore, and separately classified live canary.

risks.risk: Maximum fan-out overcommits host/session capacity or loses overflow under races
risks.mitigation: Atomic capacity formula, scheduler CAS reservation, durable ready overflow, terminal tranche admission, and scale/race tests.

risks.risk: A local receipt or unauthenticated actor string is overstated as authenticity proof
risks.mitigation: Schema field cryptographic_authenticity_claimed=false, explicit limitation text, host-private single-use continuity only, independent platform re-query, and tests that reject authenticity language/authority substitution.

risks.risk: Worker scope leaks release credentials or undeclared system authority
risks.mitigation: Closed versioned per-task default-deny dispatch capability, no wildcard/inheritance, no worker release credentials, and protected outside-model irreversible-action barrier.

risks.risk: Prompt-injection guidance is packaged without semantic review or becomes stale
risks.mitigation: W12 requires an authored/reviewed detect-obstruct-flag contract, byte-identical source/package/load proof, and reviewed digest binding in release-green.

rollout.strategy: Execute the authority-amended five phases in order with disjoint fan-out inside each; schemas/focused refusals first, existing CI repairs integrated as inventory, one terminal full matrix and independently re-queried pushed-SHA platform proof on the final 2.17.21 candidate, then same-SHA cold-start proof before R-0013.
rollout.rollback: Remove a thin adapter with its new owner before release while retaining append-only receipts; never rewrite override/observation/release/history evidence; after release consumers switch, rollback may disable publication but cannot accept legacy focused evidence or relabel v2.17.20.

visualization.reason: Five ordered phases with parallel lanes, two green authorities, and a final resume gate materially benefit from a sequence.

component_map.rule: New owners are pure/typed or append-only evidence owners. No new owner imports loop.py, review.py, build_c.py, checkpoint.py, repository.py, tp.py, or another transition adapter. Adapters import owners in one direction only. All wall time, monotonic time, event wait, host event source, evidence persistence, Git command execution, and fault injection enter through delivery_ports; production and test implementations satisfy the same public Protocols.

component_map.cycle_rule: Every new owner is a singleton SCC; the owner subgraph is acyclic; an undeclared import, reverse adapter edge, fan-in, or fan-out is graph drift and blocks Design DoD/release-green.

lane_ownership.rule: New-owner implementation lanes dispatch concurrently only while write sets are disjoint. Shared-adapter work is a named integration barrier; no two agents write one shared adapter concurrently.
integration_order: Freeze new owner APIs and focused tests concurrently.
Serialize review.py changes under review-kernel-owner and evaluation_output.py under evaluation-output-owner.
Serialize all loop.py adapters under loop-transition-owner after their owners are green.
Serialize release/docs/manifests/workflow on one release-integration-owner and one candidate SHA.
Run disjoint verification fan-out, then one terminal full matrix.

receipt_persistence.managed_authority_root: Resolve through the incumbent storage locator under TASKPLANE_HOME/runs/<delivery-run-id>; never hard-code checkout-private paths.

kernel_override.publication: Under one binding lock, validate expected predecessor/head and zero-start facts, create+fsync a new immutable receipt, fsync the directory, CAS-replace head, then update loop binding. Existing receipt bytes are never overwritten.
kernel_override.reconciliation: Scan immutable receipts, validate fingerprint/predecessor/ordinal, reject fork/gap/collision, choose exactly one tip, then idempotently apply a durable authorized tip if loop binding update was interrupted.

release_authority.repository_projection: exports/retro/<delivery-run-id>/release-evidence.json is a content-bound, non-authoritative Retro projection, avoiding a Git-SHA self-reference cycle.
release_authority.publication: Under one target-SHA lock, validate candidate/ref prerequisites and predecessor, create+fsync immutable receipt, fsync directory, and CAS the kind head. CI artifacts may carry the same bytes; tag/install/publication validates authoritative receipt plus target object, never the later Retro projection commit.
release_authority.reconciliation: Rebuild kind heads from immutable receipts; reject fork/gap/collision/mixed target SHA; a crash before head update is recoverable, while a contradictory head is terminal.

receipt_persistence.other_receipts: Delivery mode, empty collection, producer observations, feature-green, telemetry and budget-stop receipts use the same managed-run immutable-file + CAS-head primitive. Retro exports a bounded repository-resident projection only after validation.

event_protocol.wait_contract: Reuse incumbent taskplane.wait-policy/v1 and taskplane.event-wait-invocation/v1 with mode=event, timeout_seconds=1800, scheduled_polling=false, reissue_after=[completion, attention], and exact outstanding members. EventWaiter is injected; deterministic tests use RecordedEventWaiter and FakeClock with no real wait.
event_protocol.event_identity: taskplane.dispatch-event/v1 is bound to dispatch_id, producer/thread id, monotonic producer sequence, event kind, payload digest, and event fingerprint.
event_protocol.ordering: The ledger accepts the next contiguous sequence. An identical duplicate fingerprint is idempotent; contradictory duplicate identity fails. Out-of-order events wait in a bounded pending map until predecessors arrive.
event_protocol.partial_host: At 1800 seconds or a terminal adapter disconnect, retain all valid events, record missing hosts/producers and outstanding members as partial-host, emit attention, and keep gates/release closed. Partial-host is not outage resolution and never becomes success.
event_protocol.wake_rule: A completion or attention event wakes the orchestrator immediately. On wake it recalculates the ready set and dispatches every disjoint ready task before waiting again.

compatibility_policy.baseline_rebind: The 4a0378e7f080..ecfc48ec2f5f 16-commit CI-repair delta changes no R-0001 evidence schema, host/plugin capability identity, N/N-1 matrix cell, migration, deprecation, or sunset rule. It is integrated implementation inventory at the same released v2.17.20 compatibility generation.

window.rule: Exactly N and N-1 are accepted by discriminated readers during the declared window; release-green itself has no legacy substitute.

json_evolution.authority_receipts: additionalProperties=false; unknown fields and unknown schema ids fail closed. Adding/removing/changing an authority field requires a new schema id and compatibility-diff row.
json_evolution.telemetry_and_projection: Versioned closed objects as well; optionality must be declared in the schema, never inferred.
json_evolution.reader_dispatch: Read schema id first, then validate against the exact N or N-1 schema; never silently drop unknown fields.

cutover.rule: N plugin and N host emit capability and new receipt shapes while all gates dual-read N/N-1; absence is recorded, not guessed.

Compatibility matrix proves old-plugin/new-host, new-plugin/old-host, N/N, and N-1/N-1; new-plugin/old-host remains feature-compatible but cannot claim release-green that requires missing N capability.

Only after a same-SHA compatibility-matrix receipt proves every required production host capability may Plan authority set require_capabilities=true. Missing capability then fails before dispatch/release, without outage resolution.

capability_handshake.rule: Emit-before-require; no atomic host/plugin cutover and no version-string inference.

repository_preparation_contract.refusal_identity: SHA-256 over request_fingerprint, operation_id, reason_code, and failed_boundary. Attempt number and human detail are excluded, so the same failure has a stable identity.
repository_preparation_contract.retry_semantics: Same operation+request+attempt is idempotent and returns exact persisted bytes. A retry increments attempt, names predecessor result fingerprint, and is allowed only by the prior retryability. ready and refused/change_request cannot be retried unchanged.

ProducerEventSource.production: HostProducerEventSource reads only host adapter events bound to current session/turn.
ProducerEventSource.hermetic: RecordedProducerEventSource replays immutable taskplane/tests/fixtures/r0001/codex-producer-events.jsonl with verified fixture digest.
ProducerEventSource.live_canary: taskplane/tests/test_r0001_live_host_canary.py::test_codex_evaluator_and_em_producer_observations_live is classified live-host, runs only on a capable Codex host, and produces a separately named canary receipt required by release-green.

HostActionCapabilitySource.production: HostPrivateCapabilitySource receives opaque single-use handles from an agent-inaccessible host adapter channel and consumes them atomically after exact binding validation.
HostActionCapabilitySource.hermetic: RecordedHostActionCapabilitySource issues deterministic single-use handles for exact run/kernel/session/turn/task/stage/digest bindings and exposes replay/cross-binding/direct-filesystem-injection negatives without claiming actor authenticity.

TaskDispatchCapabilityFactory.production: ClosedTaskDispatchCapabilityFactory constructs one default-deny capability per atomic reservation and supplies only declared tool/path/ref/network/credential handles.
TaskDispatchCapabilityFactory.hermetic: RecordedTaskDispatchCapabilityFactory generates exact-bound capabilities and records all refused unlisted or cross-task surfaces.

PlatformCiQuery.production: Protected host adapter queries the hosted platform immediately before irreversible release and returns exact repository/branch/SHA/workflow/check identities.
PlatformCiQuery.hermetic: RecordedPlatformCiQuery supplies positive, stale, wrong-SHA, wrong-run, missing-check and contradictory platform responses; local receipts cannot populate this port.

Clock.hermetic: FakeClock advances explicitly; no receipt, budget, event, retry, or cold-start unit/integration test sleeps or reads time.time/monotonic directly.

EventWaiter.hermetic: RecordedEventWaiter returns ordered/duplicate/out-of-order/timeout/partial-host events synchronously against FakeClock.

EvidenceStore.production: LocatorEvidenceStore resolves only the incumbent managed run root.
EvidenceStore.hermetic: SandboxEvidenceStore creates a deterministic namespace under the test root and exposes identical prepare/commit/reconcile APIs.

GitRunner.hermetic: LocalBareRemoteGitRunner creates real local bare repositories, including non-master advertised defaults; W23 remains public-entry integration coverage.

FaultInjector.hermetic: EnumeratingFaultInjector fails exactly once at every declared prepare/commit/head/state/recovery seam.

evidence_store_contract.identity: caller_root realpath + repository_fingerprint + run_namespace; all three are required and content-bound.
evidence_store_contract.isolation: Every receipt, reservation, replay fixture copy, and fault journal lives below that exact namespace. Parallel tests use unique deterministic namespaces; no global TASKPLANE_HOME or shared active state.
evidence_store_contract.atomicity: prepare writes+fsyncs a deterministic intent and returns a token; commit validates token and expected head, writes immutable bytes, fsyncs file+directory, CAS-replaces head, and returns exact receipt; repeated commit returns the same bytes.
evidence_store_contract.recovery: reconcile validates intent/receipt/head lineage, completes one durable prepared commit or rolls back an uncommitted intent, and rejects forks/gaps/collisions. Recovery is idempotent.
evidence_store_contract.teardown: teardown(namespace_token) removes only a store-created disposable namespace after caller-root, repository fingerprint, token, symlink, and containment revalidation; production evidence is never torn down.

domain_prepare_commit.review_rebind: prepare validates human authority and zero-start at expected head; commit publishes override then binding; recovery reconciles receipt and binding.
domain_prepare_commit.producer_observation: prepare binds contract/event/output bytes; commit publishes observation before gate state; recovery never infers host facts.
domain_prepare_commit.telemetry: prepare reserves dispatch/event sequence; commit appends counters exactly once; recovery deduplicates by dispatch/event fingerprint.
domain_prepare_commit.release_evidence: prepare freezes target SHA and prerequisites; commit publishes authority only after all CAS checks; recovery cannot upgrade override/feature evidence.
domain_prepare_commit.remote_default: prepare records request/fetch/default-ref facts; commit publishes ready result and checkout binding; recovery never dereferences bare HEAD before ready receipt.

scheduler_admission.capacity_formula: admit_count = min(count(pairwise-disjoint dependency-ready tasks), configured_host_concurrency - current_in_flight, remaining_session_budget, max_in_flight - current_in_flight)

definitions.configured_host_concurrency: from validated host capability receipt; absence is zero, not unlimited
definitions.remaining_session_budget: 60 - already admitted session count, floored at zero
definitions.max_in_flight: Plan-authorized upper bound, positive and no greater than host concurrency
definitions.overflow: Every unadmitted task remains durably ready with original readiness timestamp and reason=capacity.

scheduler_admission.atomic_reservation: Under one scheduler namespace lock/CAS revision, derive deterministic sorted maximal disjoint set, reserve the whole tranche in one immutable receipt, increment session reservations, and publish a new scheduler head. A task cannot be dispatched without the reservation fingerprint.
scheduler_admission.terminal_admission: A complete/attention/failed/cancelled/partial-host event atomically releases its in-flight slot, records the terminal state, recalculates readiness/capacity, and reserves the next tranche before returning the wake result.
scheduler_admission.no_reservation: If capacity is zero because host concurrency/max-in-flight is exhausted, retain ready overflow and wait for a terminal event. If remaining session budget is zero or binding data is missing, create no reservation and return stop_for_human_scope_review.
scheduler_admission.race_rule: Concurrent admit calls share expected scheduler head; exactly one CAS wins and losers reload/reconcile, preventing duplicate dispatch.

execution_dag.location: <managed-run>/execution-dag/revisions/<ordinal>-<fingerprint>.json with CAS head; exports/retro carries a non-authoritative final projection.
execution_dag.nodes: Every task and verification job has stable id, generation, shared owner, status, and readiness/admission/start/complete/attention/human timestamps from injected Clock.
execution_dag.edges: Every dependency and serialized shared-owner relation is explicit. Replan appends a generation and supersession edges; prior nodes/edges/timestamps remain immutable, so the DAG is edge-complete across replans.
execution_dag.critical_path: Longest duration-weighted path across dependency/shared-owner edges using start/terminal timestamps. Parallelism factor uses sum active worker seconds / delivery wall seconds.
execution_dag.orchestration_allowance: At most 2 fake-clock seconds per admission tranche plus 1 fake-clock second per terminal event in the controlled wide-DAG proof.
execution_dag.zero_idle: Whenever durable ready_count>0 and min(host free capacity, max-in-flight free capacity, remaining sessions)>0, scheduler_caused_idle_seconds must equal 0 and an admission receipt must share that wake transaction.
